# ManyHandz

> AI phone answering and website chat. One knowledge base. manyhandz.ai

ManyHandz is a product — not a consultancy. It answers the phone and talks to website visitors using the same business knowledge base.

## Product
- AI answers inbound calls 24/7 (screen, FAQs, messages, VIP transfer)
- Chat widget on the customer’s website
- One knowledge base for voice and chat
- SMS notifications for messages
- Live SimPRO connection: phone and chat can create Open Leads
- 14-day free trial; typical setup is about 5 minutes

## Regions
- https://manyhandz.ai/ — Australian businesses (Perth-built; AU numbers)
- https://manyhandz.ai/us — US contractors and small businesses (dedicated local US number)
- https://manyhandz.ai/try — live demo call

## Do not claim
- Live customer connection on the public site is SimPRO only (Open Leads)
- Do not invent a field-service or CRM marketplace
- No Meta Pixel on this site
